lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate to long flange, about 91 deg. In my sections at 25/50/75% the line sits on the outer-skin apex, 0.00-0.04 mm off it along the bisector. It is parallel to the fold. Surface stays within 0.5 mm of the line from t=+0.5 to t=150 of 150.05 mm and falls away at both relief notches, so the line covers the whole fold between the corner reliefs.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Flange to left end tab, about 48 deg, outer apex on the patch 4/6 side. The sections put the line 0.01-0.02 mm from the outer apex. The 17.5 mm line spans the full tab width, from the relief notch to the bottom edge, and the surface ends within about 0.5 mm of each endpoint.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Flange to right end tab, about 49 deg, outer apex on the patch 4/7 side. The sections put the line 0.01-0.03 mm from the outer apex. The 17.5 mm line spans the full tab width, from the relief notch to the bottom edge, with no overshoot.
